question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Calculate total runs conceded and wickets taken per bowler
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(br.runs_scored) AS total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored br ON b.match_id = br.match_id AND b.over_id = br.over_id AND b.ball_id = br.ball_id AND b.innings_no = br.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_extras AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(er.extra_runs) AS total_extras
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    br.total_runs_conceded,
    COALESCE(be.total_extras, 0) AS total_extras,
    COALESCE(br.total_runs_conceded, 0) + COALESCE(be.total_extras, 0) AS total_runs,
    bw.total_wickets,
    ROUND(1.0 * (COALESCE(br.total_runs_conceded, 0) + COALESCE(be.total_extras, 0)) / bw.total_wickets, 2) AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
LEFT JOIN bowler_extras be ON br.bowler = be.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 20
